newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra, CSL in R&D deal.
newsitem.headline: Astra, CSL in R&D deal.

text.p: Swedish drugs group Astra said on Wednesday it had entered into a cooperation agreement with Australian CSL Ltd. relating to the development of immunotherapy against the helicobacter pylori bacteria believed to cause gastric ulcers.
"The agreement provides Astra with an exclusive licence and global commercial rights to CSL's portfolio of H. pylori intellectual property," Astra said in a statement.
Astra's drug Losec, or omeprazole, has been approved in combination with antibiotics to rid peptic ulcer sufferers of H. pylori. A vaccine against the bacterium is in the pipeline, Astra said.

"Early preclinical data indicate that H. pylori infections could be cured by immunization, indicating that an effective future vaccine could replace antibiotics as the complementary product to Losec for treatment of peptic ulcers and other diseases caused by H. pylori," it said.
